ctx.x: I've never heard him. Never heard him. Oh, he was good. He teaches school, him and Rudy Humphrey, over that night. Yeah, he was good. He had been to office, but he didn't, he didn't take him. He stayed up there. And after he got married, I believe he got about eight or nine kids on there.
